summary: Code quality of provided files is strong (Set-StrictMode, proper error handling, pinned action refs, least-privilege perms), but deliverable is incomplete and unverifiable: missing tests/ArtifactCleanup.Tests.ps1 (required by workflow line 24), fixtures/sample.json (referenced as default in cleanup-plan), and test harness to run `act` multiple times producing act-result.txt (explicit requirement: 'act-result.txt file MUST exist'). Task mandates 'ALL TESTS MUST RUN THROUGH ACT' — none do. Design flaw: workflow_dispatch dry_run input defined but not wired to cleanup-plan job (job only reads $env:DRYRUN from external harness). Without tests/fixtures/harness, cannot verify the solution works end-to-end.
